title: Mark McCandlish's alien reproduction vehicles

tellings.quote: then the Mark McCandish like alien reproduction vehicles like we have workable craft that uses,

plain: A man named Mark McCandlish spoke of "alien reproduction vehicles": craft said to be built by copying alien technology. Michels brings it up in passing as an example of the claim that the United States has working craft of this kind. If true, it would mean such technology is not just studied but flown.
